minimal_reproduction: A 15-line Win32 program that registers a DefWindowProcA class and calls CreateWindowExA prints hwnd=00000000 err=1400 and exits 2. RegisterClassA succeeds; only window creation fails.
scope: Affects every GUI program in the open-igi bottle: retail igi.exe, the candidate, and the trivial test above. Not specific to any native or to our source.
earlier_evidence: The same candidate ran a level at 7.3 FPS as recently as 2026-10-22T07:16Z, per igi.log. After that timestamp every launch logs 'Create model-scene window failed.'
ruled_out: Not the Frida server: killing frida-server-x86.exe changed nothing.
Not the launch form: both --cx-app and plain wine fail identically.
Not the mutex: no game process is running.
Not the build: cmake reports '[100%] Built target igi' and the binary is unchanged.
likely_cause: The macOS graphics session that CrossOver draws into is no longer available to this process context (for example a locked or logged-out WindowServer session, or a sandbox without window-server access).
consequence: Paired Frida runtime capture cannot proceed. Every in-game observation, including the --require-frida-probes gate, is blocked until a GUI session is available.
next_step: Restore an interactive desktop session for the account running the bottle, then re-run scripts/frida_401050_pair.py --level 1.
